high_level_description: This image captures a woman standing by the water, facing away from the camera. She is wearing a black sleeveless dress that flows down to her ankles. Her long, dark hair is flowing freely, suggesting a gentle breeze. She has one hand raised, touching her hair, which adds a sense of movement and grace to the scene. The background features a marina with several boats docked. The boats vary in size and design, indicating a mix of leisure and possibly commercial vessels. In the distance, there is a building with large windows, likely a part of the marina facilities or a nearby establishment.
